```{python}
#| label: setup
#| code-summary: "Setup and data loading"
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# The course repository is cloned next to this repository. The loader tries the
# relative path first and falls back to the course GitHub URL (see code/00_load.py).
sys.path.append("code")
sys.path.append("../code")
from importlib import import_module
load = import_module("00_load")

data = load.load_all()
panel, meta, geolift, journeys = data["panel"], data["meta"], data["geolift"], data["journeys"]
BUDGET_WEEKLY_K = load.weekly_budget_2027(panel)
print(f"Data root: {load.data_root()}")
print(f"2027 weekly budget: {BUDGET_WEEKLY_K:,.2f} thousand EUR per week ({52 * BUDGET_WEEKLY_K:,.0f} thousand EUR over 52 weeks)")
```

## 1. The decision and the data

<!-- The manager's question. What the panel, country metadata, geo-lift and journey data
contain; one descriptive figure (spend mix by country) and one table (2025 spend and sales). -->

```{python}
#| label: fig-spend-mix
#| fig-cap: "2025 average weekly media spend by country and channel (thousand EUR)"
spend_cols = [f"spend_{ch}_k" for ch in load.CHANNELS]
y2025 = panel[panel.week.dt.year == 2025]
mix = y2025.groupby("country")[spend_cols].mean()
mix.columns = load.CHANNELS
ax = mix.plot(kind="bar", stacked=True, figsize=(8, 4))
ax.set_ylabel("thousand EUR per week"); ax.set_xlabel("")
ax.legend(title="", ncol=5, fontsize=8, loc="upper right")
plt.tight_layout()
```

## 5. The 2027 allocation

<!-- Budget constraint (stated above), optimisation approach, at least two scenarios,
expected incremental revenue and uncertainty per scenario, the recommended allocation. -->

```{python}
#| label: tbl-allocation
#| tbl-cap: "Recommended 2027 weekly allocation (thousand EUR per week)"
alloc = pd.read_csv("allocation_2027.csv")
wide = alloc.pivot(index="country", columns="channel", values="weekly_spend_k")[load.CHANNELS]
wide["total"] = wide.sum(axis=1)
assert abs(alloc.weekly_spend_k.sum() - BUDGET_WEEKLY_K) / BUDGET_WEEKLY_K < 0.005, "allocation does not sum to the budget"
wide.round(2)
```
